newsitem.title: USA: Montana Power completes Vessels asset acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Montana Power completes Vessels asset acquisition.

text.p: Montana Power Co said Thursday that it has completed the $85 million acquisition of privately-held Vessels Energy Inc's oil and gas assets in the Denver-Julesburg Basin.

The purchase, completed April 23, was made through North American Resources Co, Montana Power's U.S. oil and gas subsidiary, and represents the largest acquisition in Montana Power's history, said the company.
Montana Power is an international, diversified, investor-owned electric and natural gas utility based in Butte, Montana. Vessels is a closely-held Denver-based company.
